description: Quality gate checklists per phase. Single source of truth: state.py reads this file, references/gates.md explains how to use it. Items may be marked n/a with a note when the condition does not apply.

discover.item: Personas and primary use cases described
Target platforms confirmed by the user
Constraints recorded: budget, timeline, hosting, team skills
Personal data and GDPR impact assessed (data categories, legal basis, retention)
Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA default) and languages/i18n targets set
Risk level L0-L3 assigned and confirmed by the user
Product name chosen by the user (or n/a)
L0-L1 only: lightweight stack decision recorded (else n/a, decided in PLAN)

specify.item: Every requirement has id, kind, MoSCoW priority and source
Every story links at least one requirement and has self-contained context
Every acceptance criterion is observable and has a verification method
MVP scope explicit: IN and OUT lists
Non-functional requirements covered: performance, security, privacy, accessibility
Open questions resolved, or listed and marked HYPOTHESIS
No invented requirements: derived ones are marked source=derived and confirmed

plan.item: Stack decision matrix with recommendation + 2 alternatives per area; user decision recorded as ADR
Container decision recorded as ADR (container setup or reasons for none)
Data model, integrations and external services listed
STRIDE threat model with mitigations mapped to requirements or tasks
Brand: design tokens pass contrast_check.py, logo chosen by the user (or n/a)
Wireframes for key flows on each target platform (or n/a for non-UI projects)
Environments, branching, versioning (SemVer) and CI strategy defined
Licenses of chosen dependencies compatible with the project license
Risk register: probability x impact, mitigation, owner

tasks.item: Every story (except wont) has at least one task with an owner
Complexity scored; tasks above threshold split into subtasks
Tasks reference the standards to load
UAT case for every criterion verified by UAT; steps written for a non-technical tester
Execution order / milestones agreed with the user

implement.item: All must-have tasks completed with evidence
TDD: failing test written before each new behavior or bug fix
CI green: lint, typecheck, tests (command output recorded)
No secrets in the repository (gitleaks or equivalent check)
Handoff to QA for each completed story

verify.item: Automated test suite executed; results recorded with commands
Every acceptance criterion has status met/not_met with evidence
UAT executed by the user; no open blocker or major defect
Security checks run (SCA, SAST, secrets, container, DAST if approved) or NOT RUN justified
No open blocker security finding; majors fixed or risk accepted by the user
Accessibility review against WCAG 2.2 AA (or n/a)
UX review on each target platform (or n/a)

release.item: Deploy checklist completed; rollback procedure written and tested
Backups, logging, metrics and alerts in place
Store checklists completed for mobile targets (or n/a)
Privacy notice and GDPR documentation ready (or n/a)
README, runbook and user documentation updated
User explicitly approved the go-live (irreversible action)

evolve.item: Standards extracted or updated from the real code
Retrospective written: what worked, what to change
